text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Bahraini business group to donate 145,000 dinars to drug and alcohol rehabilitation centre at psychiatric hospital.
- Bahrain's insurance companies study new tactics as market opens up to international competition.
- Information Ministry looks into ways to boost tourism in Bahrain.
- Labour and Social Ministry agrees to raise Bahrain training institute's budget to 800,000 dinars. Institute plans to train 5,500 students by year 2001.
- More bourses in region to be linked soon, Bahrain bourse's chairman says.
